Definition: Whether and how the central bank participates in payment system governance beyond its regulatory oversight role, including board representation, operational management, technical standard-setting, or direct system operation.
Comments: BCV manages/operates SGDL and SIGMA, manages SICIL (operated by SISP), full oversight per Lei 10/VI/2002 and Lei 61/VIII/2014, adopts BIS 24 principles. BCV 10% owner SISP, board rep as Chairman (SISP 2020/2024 reports). Legislative Decree 7/2018 regulates payments. [SISP 2020 Report](https://www.sisp.cv/docs/SISP%20ANNUAL%20REPORT%202020.pdf); [SISP 2024 Report](https://www.sisp.cv/docs/SISP%20-%20ANNUAL%20REPORT2024.pdf)

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: SICIL (Sistema Integrado de Compensação Interbancária e Liquidação) partially deployed for electronic credit transfers and card payments via SISP operator, with statistics published Dec 2025 (190k operations). SPEED instant P2P system announced by BCV governor for Q1 2026 launch after successful pilot with 4 banks; works offline for inclusion.
